scripts.dev:client: npm run build -w @wse/shared && npm run dev -w @wse/client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @wse/shared && npm run dev -w @wse/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @wse/shared && npm run typecheck -w @wse/server && npm run typecheck -w @wse/client
scripts.build: npm run build -w @wse/shared && npm run build -w @wse/server && npm run build -w @wse/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @wse/shared && npm run build -w @wse/server && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
